snippet.title: SparkLine v1.5.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Tap the circles to the rhythm of a vibrant lineup of songs spanning many genres and make your journey alongside the netizens of the World of Spark!

[Story]

The latest craze of the gaming world, the VR MMORPG "World of Spark" is what's on everyone's mind these days. Bringing a virtual world experience that feels just as real as real life is.

Enter an original cast of 8 characters, each making up only a small part of the virtual world. Experience the interactions between them and immerse yourself in everyone's journey!

[Game Features]
- Over 50 songs to choose from and play, including more than 20 original songs
- Simple gameplay where you can tap anywhere on the screen and enjoy the music
- Normal to Master: Three difficulty levels catering to all skill sets
- Discover a story of people with various backgrounds simply enjoying their time inside the virtual World of Sparks... or perhaps there's more to it than meets the eye?

SparkLine Download Links
iOS: https://apple.co/3Kpsd0b
Android: https://bit.ly/454Cozc

X (formerly Twitter): https://twitter.com/SparkLine_EN
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/SBGNUjwCvx
Website: https://wizdreamgames.com/

Trailer Song: Dependent Abnormalism
Composer: Purukichi feat. nasaki
Art: clishee
